Rustage hit 2/14

Rustage hit 6/14

Rustage hit 9/14

Rustage hit 10/14 (run into solo)
Rustage hit 11/14 (run into solo)
Rustage hit 12/14 (run into solo)
Rustage hit 13/14 (run into solo)
Raven solo: all on but the loops (10); pole 7 lime
Pole 7 fades to dark as she comes in
Starfire solo: all on but the pole (7); loops lavender
Thunderclap: hard cut to black
Thunderclap: one big white flash, fading out
Slade: slow fade up to orange right after the lightning, full as he starts talking (2:02.15); only 1, 4, 7, 10, 11 — the rest black
Battle starts (2:26.79): Slade’s five pools out…
…and the other seven on, in orange
Battle: soft pulse — snaps up on each beat and eases down to 35%
First pulse: the seven go dark, the five battle pools take over
Battle (2:39.25): the other seven to full, the five out — so hit 1 lands as a flip
Battle hits 1–8: all five battle pools strobe
Hit 1: the seven snap off as the five start strobing
Battle hits 9–16: the strobe flips to the other seven
Battle (2:54.28): the five back to full, the seven out — so the first post-battle hit lands as a flip
Post-battle hits (5): the seven snap on and fade quickly; pairs held as one flash
First post-battle hit: the five snap off as the seven flash
Victory: fade up to the intro colours
Victory: piano on the 1 of bars 1–3 — snap up, ring down to 50%; the 4th lands on the drums switch
Drums: hold look A (the victory colours) through the first bar
Drums: switch to look B on the 1 of bar 2 (3:08.34)
Drums: B on the 2& — each colour shifted one along (lime→lavender→red→orange→blue→lime)
Drums: A back on the 1 from bar 3, swapping with B on the 2&
Victory: flip between look A and look B on every 8th note from 3:17.50 to 3:22, like the finale
Victory: switch to look B (each colour one along) and hold to 3:31
Victory: switch to look C (each colour two along) and hold to the finale
Finale: every light flips between look A and look B on every 8th note
Finale: the last hit — look A at full
Fade to black with the music (silent by about 3:51.9)
